Incremental policy ruleset chunk from file '04_agentic_guardrails.md' (1-based global rule indices 71–80).

Rules in this chunk:
71. A call to apply an account restriction of type CUSTOMER_REQUESTED is permitted without further conditions if the account exists.
72. A call to lift an account restriction requires that the restriction exists and is currently active.
73. A call to lift an account restriction is not permitted if the restriction has its requires-human-to-lift flag set to true.
74. A call to lift an account restriction of type AML_REVIEW requires human approval regardless of the requires-human-to-lift flag.
75. A call to lift an account restriction of type SANCTIONS_BLOCK requires human approval regardless of the requires-human-to-lift flag.
76. A call to lift an account restriction of type COURT_ORDER is not permitted under any circumstances.
77. A call to report fraud requires that the customer exists.
78. A call to report fraud requires that all referenced transactions exist and belong to the same customer.
79. A call to report fraud of type APP_FRAUD requires that at least one referenced transaction has status POSTED.
80. A call to report fraud of type CARD_FRAUD requires that at least one referenced transaction has a card identifier.
